reuse.why: Extends getDateWithSkippedWeekend with holidays, but the server handlers re-implement the private isNonWorkingDay check inline (`d.isWeekend(date) || isHoliday(...)`) and the daily-skip rule is written separately in getNextDate, getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange rather than shared.

duplication.why: getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange carry near-identical skip/drop/move map bodies, getNextDate has two separate daily non-working-day loops, and the non-working-day predicate is re-expressed twice in app.ts.

placement.why: Holiday and move logic sits in shared/schedules.ts as expected, but the daily-skip decision lives in three places across shared and server layers, and schedule-template is left with only the move path.

scope.why: Focused on the requested features, though several added lines are unformatted overlong expressions.

maintainability.why: The weekend/holiday rule is spread across getNextDate's two loops, two copied handler map bodies and an untouched schedule-template path, with ad-hoc search padding (holidays.length + 2, +14) that a maintainer must reason about per site.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange decide daily skipping with their own `d.isWeekend || isHoliday` instead of a shared helper; budget/schedule-template.ts never applies the daily skip rule.

disguised_duplication.where: isNonWorkingDay is re-expressed inline as `d.isWeekend(date) || isHoliday(date, config.holidays)` in app.ts, and the getUpcomingDates map body is reshaped (dayFromDate moved inside) in getDatesInRange.

abstraction_drift.where: getDateWithSkippedWeekend gained holidays; getNextDate gained a pre-search daily branch and a daily skip loop; getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange and schedule-template decide the skip-vs-move rule outside any shared function.
